'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Kurt Schlichting LS Kessel''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kurt Schlichting]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' light side pile
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
